faq.a1: No. It only advises. Every swap and rebalance needs a person to approve it, and that decision is written to the audit log.
faq.q2: Where do the numbers come from?
faq.a2: From forecasting models trained on synthetic transactions. The AI writes wording only; it never computes or changes a number.
faq.a3: Each forecast shows a low-to-high band and a confidence value. A wide band means less certainty, so check before acting.
faq.q4: What do Safe, Watch and Act now mean?
faq.a4: They are risk levels for running out of cash or e-money within the next 6, 24 or 72 hours. They always come with an icon and a word, not colour alone.
faq.q5: Why do I see Bangla digits?
faq.a5: Digits follow your preference. Change them under Settings, Digits.
faq.q6: Is any of this real customer data?
faq.a6: No. Every agent, balance and transaction is synthetic, generated for this demo.

read.gaugeBody: The liquid level is today's balance against capacity. The low and high tide marks show the safe range. Cash has stripes, e-money has dots.
read.runwayBody: The line is the expected balance, the band is the low-to-high range. The flag marks the likely stockout time; event ribbons show salary days, Eid, hat-bazar and rain.
read.countdownBody: Time until the float likely runs dry, with a confidence ring. The card border follows the risk level.
read.whyBody: Reasons behind the prediction, strongest first. The model chip marks numbers; the AI-generated chip marks wording only.

help.tourBody: A short walk through search, notifications, navigation and your account menu.
help.contactBody: In a live rollout this connects to your distributor's help desk. This demo shows no real contact details.

about.lead: AgentPulse AI predicts when an MFS agent's cash or e-money will run out, explains why, and suggests a fix that a person approves.
about.syntheticBody: Agents, balances and transactions are generated with a fixed seed. They follow realistic patterns such as salary days, Eid, hat-bazar days and rain, but no real person or account is involved.
about.step1: Hourly cash-in and cash-out are forecast for the next 72 hours with quantile gradient boosting (low, expected, high).
about.step2: Balances are rolled forward from the current float to find the likely stockout time and its confidence.
about.step3: Risk at 6, 24 and 72 hours comes from fixed business rules over those numbers.
about.step4: SHAP values explain each prediction; an AI model may polish the wording, but numbers always come from the backend and are checked.
about.gateNote: The last 14 days are held out from training. A model ships only if it beats the same-hour-last-week baseline on them.
about.limitsStatic: Forecasts are less certain for new agents, rare events and days unlike the training data. Always check the band before acting.
about.raiBody: The system is advisory only. A person approves anything that moves money, every decision is logged with a note, and fairness is checked across urban and rural groups.
